programmes.name: Free Training
programmes.commitment: Eight weeks per cohort · 40 seats per track
programmes.lede: Two doors, one institution. Learn a creative or technical craft, or prepare for the exams that decide what you can study next. Neither costs tuition.
programmes.body: KR8 Academy has run four cohorts and is now taking its fifth. Every track is eight weeks long, taught live by working practitioners on Monday, Wednesday and Friday evenings (8–9pm WAT), with assignments Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Nobody is charged tuition, and nobody is charged to graduate.
details: Eight weeks: beginner weeks 1–4, advanced weeks 5–8
Verifiable KR8 ID and certificate included, at no fee

programmes.name: The Tribe
programmes.owner: The Tribe · a KR8 Digitals community
programmes.commitment: Ongoing · no start or end date
programmes.lede: Isolation kills craft. A room of people who do the same work as you, who will tell you the truth about yours.
programmes.body: The Tribe is open to everyone — no KR8 ID, no test, no interview. Designers, video editors, developers, founders and people who have not made anything yet. What holds it together is a rule set: no spam, no fake gurus, radical generosity, ruthless craft standards, and lift as you climb.
details: Critique over clout — work gets reviewed by people who can actually do it
Internal gig flow — paid work moves through the community first
Interdisciplinary sprints — designers, editors and developers on one brief
Creator Hangout — a monthly showcase, not a meeting
Special Portfolio Days — capstone reviews with senior directors
programmes.note: The Tribe's own site is not live yet. Until it is, we are taking names here and opening accounts in the order they arrive.

programmes.name: Mindset Shift
programmes.lede: The session that changes what a young creative believes is possible — before the skill has a chance to matter.
programmes.body: Mindset Shift runs live every two weeks, 9pm–12am WAT. It is not a lecture. It is the conversation that most people in creative education never get: what this work actually pays, what it costs, how to price, how to be paid, how to survive the years before the work is good.
details: Speakers from KR8, Motion Verse, Chigoma and invited practitioners

programmes.name: Join the Team
programmes.commitment: 60 days of training, then paid monthly
programmes.lede: One team that delivers client contracts and runs the programmes together. Paid, permanently, from month three.
programmes.body: KR8 hires a paid team rather than contracting freelancers. Joining means enrolling in paid training: thirty days in the Consistency Drill, then thirty days of KR8 team training. After sixty days, team members are paid monthly and take part in client contracts according to their role.
details: Days 1–30: Consistency Drill — finish what you start, publicly
Days 31–60: team training — delivered on real client work
Day 61 onward: paid monthly, with client contracts and programmes
Roles: general manager, tribe manager, social media manager, editors, designers, developers
